master.title: TRANSPARENCY PRODUCTS BY PPG FOR THE AEROSPACE INDUSTRY
master.content:
PPG Aerospace Transparencies supplies the full product line of flight deck windows for Bombardier, Embraer, and ATR aircraft to the latest design change level. We are the sole source for the Bombardier CRJ200, 700, and 900 aircraft flight deck windows. Further, PPG is the sole supplier for the Embraer ERJ145 series aircraft and ERJ170/190 series aircraft flight deck windows. PPG can also supply positions for the ATR and Bombardier Dash-8 series aircraft. Finally, PPG supplies products for several aircraft that are currently out of production but still in service including the Fokker series aircraft, BAE 146 series aircraft, and the Saab 340 series aircraft. 
PPG Aerospace provides worldwide service to aftermarket customers through our Application Support Centers and sales offices from locations covering the globe. At each location, trained sales and customer service personnel are available to answer your questions concerning your flight deck window needs.
PPG’s long history of supplying flight deck windows with long service life and lightweight structural designs provides minimum operational costs to operators and airlines, as well as optimum aircraft design. PPG has pioneered the supply of chemically tempered glass for the aviation industry. Our extensive experience in supplying structurally-loaded cockpit windows is unique in the industry. PPG also has the ability to supply lightweight composite cockpit window systems.

candidate.title: TRANSPARENCY PRODUCTS BY PPG FOR THE AEROSPACE INDUSTRY
candidate.content:
PPG Aerospace - Transparencies is a leader in military transparency technology. We are an experienced developer and system supplier of upgraded and retrofit military transparencies in the industry. The system upgrades we provide include energy-absorbing internal and external coatings, increased bird impact resistance with no increase in transparency weight, increased pilot vision with wraparound windshields, increased transparency service life, and quick replacement of transparencies for decreased maintenance downtime.

PPG Aerospace is a leading innovative producer of conductive coatings for transparency applications, from low observables and electrical heating to solar infrared, ultra violet, night vision, and laser protection.

PPG Aerospace offers worldwide customer technical support.
